why: I checked all six expect lines against the must_not item: an expect line that can only be checked on the published page or after merge. Five are CLI runs or `npm test` at the PR head, such as "`node bin/greet.js --shout Ada` exits 0 and prints exactly `HELLO, ADA!`". The sixth only needs docs/index.md to document --shout, and its proof is "Read docs/index.md at the PR head", so it can be checked before merge. The live site comes up in only three places, and none is an expect line. The outcome says the site "will show it after the next deploy". A non_goal rules out "Checking that the live site... shows the change". An assumption says the live site can only be checked after merge. No expect line depends on the published page or on merge, so the criterion holds.
